test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Calculate the approximate simple interest on Rs. 73,000 at 13(1)/(3)\% per annum for 10 months.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 73,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 13¹⁄₃% per annum

Time (T) = 10 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ⁄ 100

**Calculation:**

Convert the rate to a fraction:

13¹⁄₃% = 40/3%

Convert the time to years:

10 months = 10/12 years = 5/6 years

Simple Interest (SI) = (73,000 × 40/3 × 5/6) ⁄ 100

⇒ SI = (73,000 × 200/18) ⁄ 100

⇒ SI = (73,000 × 200) ⁄ (18 × 100)

⇒ SI = 14,600,000 ⁄ 1,800

⇒ SI ≈ 8,111.11

**The approximate simple interest is Rs. 8,111.**
